theme_and_art_direction.description: A premium, Godly-website level scrollytelling experience. The ПНДВ4 converter sits in the center of a void, surrounded by volumetric liquid glass fog. As the user scrolls, the monolithic black and gold 3D converter rotates, acting as the anchor. PCB-trace-like glowing orange branches shoot out from specific pins/surfaces of the 3D model to connect to floating frosted-glass data cards. It feels technical, highly reliable, and cinematic.
theme_and_art_direction.vibe: Elite engineering, aerospace-grade reliability, mysterious but precise.
theme_and_art_direction.primary_focus: The 3D converter is the absolute hero. Minimal text, maximum sensory impact.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Brutal Tech' pairing. Unbounded provides a wide, striking, aerospace-technical feel for numbers and big statements. Manrope provides extreme clarity for dense technical specs.

heading_font.usage: H1, Chapter Numbers, Massive Metric Data (e.g., '15 ЛЕТ')

body_font.usage: Specs, body text, UI labels, Callout descriptions

layout_and_spacing.structure: Single-page scrollytelling. Fixed Three.js canvas in the background. Absolute positioned SVG overlay for branch lines. Scrollable invisible sections that trigger GSAP animations.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Exaggerated. Use h-[150vh] or h-[200vh] per scroll chapter to ensure slow, deliberate rotations.
layout_and_spacing.callout_placement: Alternating asymmetry. Chapter 1: Bottom Left. Chapter 2: Top Right. Chapter 3: Center Left. Never perfectly mirrored. Allow the 3D model to breathe in the negative space.

glass_callout_card.styles: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.02)] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] p-8 max-w-sm rounded-none
glass_callout_card.internal_layout: Flex column, gap-2. Overline label (uppercase, tracked out), huge accent value (Unbounded), description text (Manrope).

connector_branches.description: Rigid, PCB-trace style lines (90-degree angles, no soft curves) connecting the 3D model to the HTML cards.
connector_branches.styles: SVG <path> with stroke='#EA5B29' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'. Add an SVG <circle> at the anchor point on the model.
connector_branches.behavior: Coordinates calculated via Three.js Vector3.project(camera) to map 3D anchor points to 2D screen space in real-time.

motion_and_gsap.global: Lenis for smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Without it, ScrollTrigger feels choppy.
motion_and_gsap.hero_reveal: Kinetic on-load mask reveal. GSAP clip-path animation for text (line-by-line). The liquid fog parts, and the 3D converter scales up from 0.8 to 1 with an ease of 'power4.out'.

scroll_choreography.model_rotation: gsap.to(model.rotation, { x: ..., y: ..., z: ..., scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#section-1', scrub: 1 } })
scroll_choreography.branches: Use GSAP DrawSVG (or stroke-dashoffset) to animate the lines shooting out from the model as the section enters the viewport.
scroll_choreography.cards: gsap.from(card, { y: 40, opacity: 0, backdropFilter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 1, scrollTrigger: { toggleActions: 'play reverse play reverse' } })

threejs_3d_execution.model_construction: Since it's vanilla JS/Three.js, build the ПНДВ4 converter using primitives (BoxGeometry for the black body, CylinderGeometry for the gold pins) if no GLTF is provided. Group them.
threejs_3d_execution.materials: MeshPhysicalMaterial for ultimate realism. Body: color '#111', roughness 0.7, metalness 0.2. Pins: color '#D4AF37', roughness 0.2, metalness 1.0. Logo: add an orange decal or separate geometry for the running man.
threejs_3d_execution.environment: Liquid glass fog. Implement via volumetric shaders OR, simpler: multiple overlapping planes with custom simplex noise shaders placed around the model. Slow time-based uniforms to make the fog 'breathe'.
threejs_3d_execution.lighting: High contrast. RectAreaLights or SpotLights to create dramatic reflections on the metallic pins and the matte black casing.

chapter_0_hero.title: ПНДВ4
chapter_0_hero.subtitle: Высоконадежные DC/DC преобразователи для ответственных сфер применений.

chapter_1_power.label: Мощность
chapter_1_power.desc: Типовой КПД до 80%. Работа в режиме холостого хода. Полный комплекс встроенных защит.

chapter_2_voltage.label: Вход / Выход
chapter_2_voltage.desc: Входные сети: «E» (4.5..15В), «A» (9..36В), «B» (18..75В). Выход: 3.3, 5, 9, 12, 15, 24, 27, 48 В. Параллельное и последовательное подключение.

chapter_3_durability.label: Температура
chapter_3_durability.desc: Широкий температурный диапазон. Разработка и производство в РФ.

chapter_4_formfactor.label: Габариты
chapter_4_formfactor.desc: pin-to-pin замена MGDM-4 Gaia Converter. Безупречная интеграция. Гарантия 15 лет.

accessibility_and_fallback.prefers_reduced_motion: CRITICAL: If CSS media query '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' is true: Disable Lenis. Destroy GSAP ScrollTriggers. Hide Three.js canvas. Show a static high-res image of the converter. Stack the text sections sequentially with normal CSS scrolling. No line drawing, no flying elements.
accessibility_and_fallback.semantics: Use semantic <section> tags. Ensure every callout card is reachable via 'Tab' (add tabindex='0' if not naturally focusable, but prefer natural document flow).
accessibility_and_fallback.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all sections and cards (e.g., data-testid='chapter-1-power-card').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are building a Vanilla JS Vite project. DO NOT output React code. DO NOT try to import Shadcn UI components.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. No generic centered layouts. The design relies on the tension between the floating 3D model and the rigid, asymmetrical glass data cards.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text unless there is a heavy backdrop-blur applied.
Data must be explicitly mapped exactly as provided in 'content_mapping'. Do not invent new features or specs.
Ensure 'Rantech Orange' (#EA5B29) is the only bright color used, keeping the rest of the UI monochrome/glass.
Always use 'px' or 'rem' for precise technical layouts. Draw connector lines using raw SVG paths and update 'd' attributes via JS based on Three.js projections.
